verses.verse:
रिषभमध्यमयोर्मध्ये गान्धारद्वय कल्पना।
अपरषडज् मध्यमयोर्मध्ये कोमल धैवतः।।१९।।
verses.text: Between Ṛṣabha and Madhyama two Gāndhāras are to be devised; between the other Ṣaḍja and Madhyama, komal Dhaivata.

commentary.text: That is, between the Ṛṣabha and Madhyama notes make the marks for two Gāndhāras at equal distance. And between tāra Sa and the Madhyama note make the mark for komal Dhaivata.
